'''Kaasi brandy''' was a type of [[Brandy/Legends|brandy]] made on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. [[Elara Dorne]] took a bottle of thirty-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old brandy with her as one of her few personal effects when she defected to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was virtually impossible to acquire in the Republic, and it took a great deal of time to retrieve her bottle once she had been made a citizen.
